name: Recording Consent
description: Agent must disclose that the call is recorded.

approved_variants: this call is being recorded for quality purposes
we may monitor and record this call for quality and training purposes
for quality purposes we may monitor and record this call
this call may be recorded and monitored

name: Account Holder Confirmed
description: Agent confirms the customer is the account holder.

approved_variants: confirm i am speaking with the account holder
am i speaking with the account holder

name: Market Offer Disclosure
description: Agent reads the required market-offer / DMO disclosure.

approved_variants: i will now read the required market offer disclosure

name: Terms Acknowledgement
description: Agent asks whether the customer understands or accepts the key terms.

approved_variants: do you understand and accept these terms
do you accept the terms and conditions
are you happy to proceed on this basis
do you understand the key terms
are you okay to proceed with these terms

name: Peak Rate Match
description: Spoken peak rate matches the selected plan rate.

name: Off-Peak Rate Match
description: Spoken off-peak rate matches the selected plan rate, when applicable.

name: Email Read-Back Match
description: Spoken email read-back matches the CRM email.

name: Address Match
description: Address spoken / confirmed matches the CRM address.

name: Plan Name Match
description: Plan name stated by the agent matches the CRM-selected plan.

name: Dead Air
description: Flag gaps longer than 30 seconds as a coaching note.

name: Crosstalk or Low Confidence
description: Flag overlapping speech, unknown speaker, or transcript confidence below 0.80 as a QA/coaching signal.
